content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains references and demonstrations of scenes of violence, such as: suicide, self-harm

If you are an impressionable person, or for you rough treatment is unacceptable, I, as the author, recommend you to refrain from playing the game

linux_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Ubuntu 10.10 or higher
  • Processor: 1 Gz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 10.10 or higher

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
